title: Concept: better_errors debug page disclosed in a response
description: The better_errors page renders the exception next to a live interactive console for the failing request. The console evaluates Ruby in the application context, so the page is not just a disclosure: on a reachable deployment it is a code-execution prompt.
applicability: Responses from a Rails application that loads the better_errors gem outside development.
risk: A live evaluation console is exposed next to the stack trace; MEDIUM severity because the console usually requires a local request but the stack does not.
